name: SEC America
old_description: SEC Tractor Trailer Electrical Interfaces provide electrical compatibility when electrical specifications between tractor and trailer do not match.
about:
SEC America Corp operates from South Burlington, Vermont, where it has maintained a track record of more than 30 years in power conversion solutions. The company functions as a design and engineering firm that also assembles its products in the United States, though no founding year or original founders are disclosed in public materials.

The company develops and manufactures rugged power conversion equipment including trailer electrical interfaces, DC‑DC converters, battery backup systems, and sealed converters. Its South Burlington facility houses engineering labs for rapid prototype development and field‑test monitoring, as well as transformer and metal fabrication capabilities that support design management and product refinement. SEC America warehouses an extensive inventory of standard off‑the‑shelf units and can ship orders placed before 1:00 PM the same day; it also offers custom mechanical and electrical design, private labeling, and warranty repair services.

SEC America serves industrial and consumer specialty markets, with a notable focus on the transportation sector where its trailer electrical interfaces resolve compatibility mismatches between tractors and trailers. The company’s design/build process targets OEMs, encouraging modification of existing designs for small‑to‑medium runs and pursuing full custom development when high volumes justify the investment.

SEC America emphasizes rugged, built‑to‑last products assembled in the U.S.A., backed by a two‑year limited warranty. The firm cites continuous communication with its manufacturing partners as a driver of cost‑effective assemblies and packaging, and it positions its in‑house fabrication and rapid‑delivery capability as key differentiators for customers needing quick turnaround on new designs.
